This software is a modded build based on AudioVideoBox (AVBox). It only provides aggregated display of content; all resources come from the internet, and the software does not host, create, upload, store, or download any content. It is provided for open-source learning purposes only; please delete it within 24 hours of installation.
Keep the credits when redistributing https://github.com/CatVodTVOfficial/TVBoxOSC https://github.com/q215613905/TVBoxOS https://github.com/XiaochangXu/AVBox
